messages.author: 7409d4321b2ec671
messages.subject: fitqtl in 1.08-56
parts:
Hello,

when I ran fitqtl to estimate QTL effects, I got following message.
> fq2.est <- fitqtl(mor0404, pheno.col=1, qtl=rq, formula=myformula, get.ests=T)
Error in solve.default(t(Z) %*% Z, t(Z) %*% X) :
system is computationally singular: reciprocal condition number =
3.67174e-19

When I ran fitqtl with get.ests=F, it seemed fine without any error
message.
I appreciate it if you would tell whether this is my data set problem.
I only phenotyped 33% of 384 F2s.

Thank you!

Masato

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] fitqtl in 1.08-56
parts:
It sounds like a multicollinearity problem; you have over-specified
the model,
perhaps by including multiple loci with indistinguishable genotypes.

karl
